quote.text: Rosebud...
quote.zh: 玫瑰花蕾……

quote.text: Of all the gin joints in all the towns in all the world, she walks into mine.
quote.zh: 世界上所有城镇的所有酒吧里，她偏偏走进了我的酒吧。

quote.text: Why should I kill myself worrying when I'll end up just as dead?
quote.zh: 为什么我要因为担心而自寻烦恼，反正最后我也会死？

quote.text: It sounded interesting, at least while I kept out of the rain. But if it's a sermon, I'd sooner listen to the rain.
quote.zh: 听起来挺有意思的，至少能让我避一避雨。但如果是布道，我宁愿听雨声。

quote.text: Romance in romantic Rome!
quote.zh: 在浪漫的罗马享受浪漫！

quote.text: We've become a race of Peeping Toms.
quote.zh: 我们都成了偷窥者。

quote.text: It’s very hard to keep personal prejudice out of a thing like this. And no matter where you run into it, prejudice obscures the truth.
quote.zh: 在这样的事情上，很难不掺杂个人偏见。无论在哪里遇到偏见，它都会掩盖真相。

quote.text: I am constantly surprised that women's hats do not provoke more murders.
quote.zh: 我总是很惊讶，女帽竟然没有引发更多的谋杀案。

quote.text: Do you believe I love you?
quote.zh: 你相信我爱你吗？

quote.text: Real diamonds! They must be worth their weight in gold!
quote.zh: 真钻石！它们一定价值连城！

quote.text: Ah, Maggie, in the world of advertising, there's no such thing as a lie. There's only the expedient exaggeration. You ought to know that.
quote.zh: 啊，Maggie，在广告界，根本不存在谎言这种东西。只有权宜之计的夸大。你应该知道这一点。

quote.text: We all go a little mad sometimes.
quote.zh: 我们每个人都会有点疯。

quote.text: Gentlemen, you can't fight in here! This is the War Room!
quote.zh: 各位先生，你们不能在这里打架！这里是战情室！

titles.en: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly

m060196.en: The Good, the Bad and the Ugly
m060196.country: 意大利 / 西班牙 / 德国

quote.text: Two hundred thousand dollars is a lot of money. We're gonna have to earn it.
quote.zh: 二十万美元是一大笔钱。我们得靠自己赚。

quote.text: I'm sorry, Dave. I'm afraid I can't do that.
quote.zh: 对不起，戴夫，恐怕我不能这么做。

quote.text: [To Alex as a Police Officer] Long time is right, I don't remember them days too horrorshow. Don't call me Dim no more either, Officer call me.
quote.zh: [对扮演警察的Alex]确实很久没见了，我不记得那些日子太美好。也不要再叫我“傻瓜”了，警官，叫我……

quote.text: I spent my life trying not to be careless. Women and children can be careless, but not men.
quote.zh: 我一生都在努力避免粗心大意。女人和孩子可以粗心大意，但男人不行。

quote.text: There's not a day in my life that I don't feel like a fraud. Other priests, doctors, lawyers - I talk to them all. I don't know anyone who hasn't felt that.
quote.zh: 我的人生中没有一天不觉得自己像个骗子。其他神父、医生、律师——我跟他们都聊过。我不知道有谁没有过这种感觉。

quote.text: I don't feel I have to wipe everybody out, Tom. Just my enemies.
quote.zh: 汤姆，我觉得我没必要消灭所有人，只要消灭我的敌人就行。

titles.en: Monty Python and the Holy Grail

quote.text: Makes Ben Hur look like an Epic!
quote.zh: 让《宾虚》看起来像是一部史诗巨片！

quote.text: [about Leatherface damaging the door with his chain saw] Look what your brother did to the door! Ain't he got no pride in his home?
quote.zh: [关于人皮脸用链锯破坏门]看看你哥哥把门弄成什么样了！他对自己的家一点自豪感都没有吗？

quote.text: All right, freeze! Nobody move!
quote.zh: 好了，别动！谁都不许动！

quote.text: Each night when I return the cab to the garage, I have to clean the cum off the back seat. Some nights, I clean off the blood.
quote.zh: 每晚把出租车开回车库时，我都得把后座上的精液擦干净。有些晚上，我还要擦掉血迹。

quote.text: A relationship, I think, is like a shark. It has to constantly move forward or it dies. And I think what we got on our hands is a dead shark.
quote.zh: 我觉得一段感情就像一条鲨鱼。它必须不断向前游，否则就会死去。我觉得我们现在面对的就是一条死鲨鱼。

titles.en: Close Encounters of the Third Kind

m075860.en: Close Encounters of the Third Kind

quote.text: Old Man: [about the UFOs] They can fly rings around the moon, but we're years ahead of them on the highway.
quote.zh: 老头：[谈到UFO]它们可以在月球周围绕圈飞行，但在公路上，我们比它们领先好几年。

quote.text: In space, no one can hear you scream.
quote.zh: 在太空，没人能听见你的尖叫。

quote.text: Have you ever considered any real freedoms? Freedoms from the opinion of others... even the opinions of yourself?
quote.zh: 您是否曾考虑过任何真正的自由？不受他人意见束缚的自由……甚至不受自己意见束缚的自由？

quote.text: It was a rough place - the seediest dive on the wharf. Populated with every reject and cutthroat from Bombay to Calcutta. It's worse than Detroit.
quote.zh: 那是个鱼龙混杂的地方——码头上最肮脏的酒吧。从孟买到加尔各答，这里聚集了形形色色的弃儿和亡命之徒。比底特律还糟。

quote.text: [to Vickie] You know how beautiful you are? Anybody ever tell you how beautiful? Yeah, tell you all the time.
quote.zh: [对Vickie]你知道你有多漂亮吗？有人告诉过你你有多漂亮吗？是的，一直都在夸我。

quote.text: Some places are like people: some shine and some don't
quote.zh: 有些地方就像人一样：有些光彩照人，有些则黯然失色。

quote.text: I'm just here for the gasoline.
quote.zh: 我只是来加油的。

quote.text: Snakes. Why'd it have to be snakes?
quote.zh: 蛇。为什么非得是蛇？

quote.text: All those moments will be lost in time, like tears in rain.
quote.zh: 所有这些时刻，终将消失在时间里，就像雨中的泪水。

quote.text: [on finding a partially-assembled spaceship beneath the tool shed] Blair's been busy out here all by himself.
quote.zh: [在工具棚下发现一艘部分组装好的宇宙飞船]布莱尔一直一个人在这里忙活。

titles.en: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

m087544.en: Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind

quote.text: Yet another village is dead.
quote.zh: 又一个村庄被毁灭了。

titles.en: Once Upon a Time in America

m087843.en: Once Upon a Time in America

quote.text: Why was that a surprise? You can always pick the winners at the starting gate - the winners and the losers. Who woulda put a penny on me?
quote.zh: 为什么这会是个惊喜？你总能在起跑线上挑出赢家——赢家和输家。谁会愿意在我身上下注一分钱？

quote.text: Come with me if you want to live.
quote.zh: 不想死就待在我身边。

quote.text: I believe virtually everything I read, and I think that is what makes me more of a selective human than someone who doesn't believe anything.
quote.zh: 我几乎相信我读到的所有内容，我认为这让我比那些什么都不相信的人更具选择性。

quote.text: Meet Marty McFly. He's broken the time barrier. Busted his parents' first date. And, maybe, botched his chances of ever being born.
quote.zh: 这位是马蒂·麦克弗莱。他打破了时间的屏障。他搅黄了父母的第一次约会。也许还搞砸了他出生的机会。

quote.text: Ordem e Progresso [Order and Progress]
quote.zh: Ordem e Progresso [秩序与进步]

quote.text: Be afraid. Be very afraid.
quote.zh: 害怕吧。非常害怕吧。

quote.text: RUUUUUN, GOOOOO! GET TO THE CHOPPER!
quote.zh: 快跑，快跑！快上直升机！

quote.text: Now I have a machine gun. Ho ho ho.
quote.zh: 现在我有机关枪了，呵呵呵。

quote.text: Just when I thought I was out, they pull me back in.
quote.zh: 就在我以为自己已经脱身的时候，他们又把我拉了回去。

quote.text: Paulie might've moved slow, but it was only because Paulie didn't have to move for anybody.
quote.zh: 保利可能行动缓慢，但那只是因为保利不用为任何人行动。

quote.text: I ate his liver with some fava beans and a nice Chianti.
quote.zh: 我吃了他的肝，配蚕豆和基安蒂酒。

quote.text: Hasta la vista, baby.
quote.zh: 后会有期，宝贝。

titles.en: Once Upon a Time in China

m103285.en: Once Upon a Time in China

quote.text: I'm going to need a gun.
quote.zh: 我需要一把枪。

quote.text: [After his pants are set on fire and a baby urinates down his leg] You saved the day there, you little pisspot. Thanks a lot.
quote.zh: [他的裤子着火后，一个婴儿在他腿上撒尿]你刚才救了我一命，你这个小尿壶。非常感谢。

quote.text: The greatest adventure is just getting back home.
quote.zh: 最棒的冒险就是回家。

quote.text: Every "dog" has its day.
quote.zh: 每只狗都有自己的一天。

quote.text: Sometimes I wish I had a thousand lifetimes. I don't know, Phil. Maybe it's not a curse. Just depends on how you look at it.
quote.zh: 有时候我希望自己有一千辈子。我不知道，菲尔。也许这不是诅咒。这完全取决于你怎么看待它。

quote.text: [To Gestapo men, as they are arresting him] I'm not saying you'll regret it, but you might. You should be aware of that.
quote.zh: [对正在逮捕他的盖世太保]我不是说你们会后悔，但你们可能会。你们应该意识到这一点。

quote.text: We're all unlucky in love sometimes. When I am, I go jogging. The body loses water when you jog, so you have none left for tears.
quote.zh: 我们有时都会在爱情中遭遇不幸。当我遇到这种情况时，我会去跑步。跑步时身体会流失水分，所以就没有水分可以用来流泪了。

quote.text: Life's a fragile thing, Harr. One minute you're chewin' on a burger, and the next minute you're dead meat.
quote.zh: 生命很脆弱，Harr。前一分钟你还在啃汉堡，下一分钟你就成了死人。

quote.text: Mama always said, dying was a part of life. I sure wish it wasn't.
quote.zh: 妈妈总是说，死亡是生命的一部分。我真希望不是这样。

quote.text: Little roar.. [scoffs]
quote.zh: 小声咆哮…… [嗤笑]

quote.text: Girls like me don't make invitations like this to just anyone!
quote.zh: 像我这样的女孩不会随便向任何人发出这样的邀请！

quote.text: It was very bitter. She said she was glad I knew, that she hated all the sneaking around. And she said that she wanted a divorce in Reno.
quote.zh: 那滋味非常苦涩。她说她很高兴我知道了，她讨厌偷偷摸摸的行事方式。她说她想在里诺离婚。

quote.text: Some guys just can't handle Vegas
quote.zh: 有些人就是受不了拉斯维加斯

quote.text: But then the morning comes, and we turn back into pumpkins, right?
quote.zh: 但天亮后，我们就会变回南瓜，对吧？

quote.text: Which would be worse: to live as a monster, or to die as a good man?
quote.zh: 是像怪物一样活着，还是像好人一样死去？

quote.text: I gotta hold on to my angst. I preserve it because I need it. It keeps me sharp [snaps fingers], on the edge [snaps fingers], where I gotta be.
quote.zh: 我得紧紧抓住我的焦虑。我保留它，是因为我需要它。它让我保持敏锐[弹指声]，处于巅峰状态[弹指声]，这就是我该有的状态。

quote.text: Just a whisper. I hear it in my ghost.
quote.zh: 只是低语。我在我的灵魂中听到了。

quote.text: [to Fundiswa, referring to the face mask] You don't need that, man. Only sissies wear that. You don't need that.
quote.zh: [对Fundiswa说，指着口罩]你不需要戴那个，伙计。只有娘娘腔才会戴那个。你不需要那个。

quote.text: What's in the box?
quote.zh: 盒子里是什么？

quote.text: There's a secret mission in uncharted space. Let's go.
quote.zh: 未知的太空中有个秘密任务。我们走吧。

quote.text: The greatest trick the devil ever pulled was convincing the world he didn't exist.
quote.zh: 魔鬼最伟大的把戏，是让世界相信他不存在。

quote.text: I think I was a pilot.
quote.zh: 我想我曾经是一名飞行员。

quote.text: No way I would poison my body with that shite. All the fucking chemicals. No fucking way!
quote.zh: 我绝不会用那种垃圾毒害我的身体。全是该死的化学物质。没门！

quote.text: It is a restless moment. She has kept her head lowered... to give him a chance to come closer. But he could not, for lack of courage. She turns and walks away.
quote.zh: 这是一个不安的时刻。她一直低着头……给他机会走近。但他做不到，因为他缺乏勇气。她转身走开。

quote.text: Well, sir, it's this rug I had. It really tied the room together.
quote.zh: 先生，是这张地毯。它真的让整个房间融为一体。

quote.text: What kind of place is this? It's beautiful: Pigeons fly, women fall from the sky! I'm moving here!
quote.zh: 这是个什么地方？这里真美：鸽子在飞，女人从天上掉下来！我要搬到这里来！

quote.zh: 罗罗·汤马西

quote.zh: 早上好！如果我没见到你，那也祝你下午好、晚上好、晚安！

quote.zh: 算了，管他呢。战斗结束了，战争胜利了。

quote.text: [To Kam Shan-chu] No men are afraid of their wives, they're only men who respects their wives.
quote.zh: [对甘山柱] 没有男人怕老婆，只有男人尊重老婆。

quote.text: No Plan. No Backup. No Choice.
quote.zh: 没有计划。没有后备方案。没有选择。

quote.text: A guy who makes a nice chair doesn't owe money to everyone who has ever built a chair.
quote.zh: 一个会制作漂亮椅子的工匠，并不欠所有曾经制作过椅子的人的钱。

quote.text: There is no spoon.

quote.text: What a lovely day!
quote.zh: 多么美好的一天！

quote.text: When the music stops, you see him in the mirror, standing behind you.
quote.zh: 音乐停止时，你在镜子里看到他站在你身后。

quote.text: You're really doing it, aren't ya? You're shitting in the street!
quote.zh: 你真的在这么做，不是吗？你在大街上拉屎！

quote.text: Look at how your Bene Gesserit propaganda has taken root. Some of them already think I'm their Messiah. Others... a false prophet.
quote.zh: 看看你们的贝尼·杰塞里特宣传是如何扎根的。他们中有些人已经认为我是他们的救世主。其他人……则认为我是假先知。

quote.text: It'll be just like in the movies. Pretending to be somebody else.
quote.zh: 就像电影里演的那样。假扮成别人。

quote.text: Some magic's real.
quote.zh: 有些魔法是真的。

quote.text: It's a great thing when you realize you still have the ability to surprise yourself. Makes you wonder what else you can do that you've forgotten about.
quote.zh: 当你意识到自己仍有能力让自己感到惊喜时，这真是件好事。这会让你不禁想知道，自己还有哪些被遗忘的能力。

quote.text: All the best memories are hers.
quote.zh: 所有最美好的回忆都属于她。

quote.zh: 一切都是信仰与偶然之间的一场神话般的宇宙大战。

quote.text: I have to believe in a world outside my own mind.
quote.zh: 我必须相信，在我的意识之外还有一个世界。

quote.text: [Facing a mob of Goto's men] No, I'm done.
quote.zh: [面对一群后藤的手下]不，我受够了。

quote.text: We're so cute. I want to punch us in the face.
quote.zh: 我们太可爱了，我想给我们一拳。

quote.text: I'm an American... Okay.
quote.zh: 我是一名美国人……好吧。

quote.text: There Are 3.7 Trillion Fish in the Ocean. They're Looking for One.
quote.zh: 海洋中有3.7万亿条鱼。它们正在寻找一条鱼。

quote.text: [As a 9-year-old] Well, he was right about one thing: I don't know when to quit.
quote.zh: [9岁时] 他有一点说对了：我不知道什么时候该放弃。

quote.text: Oh. Hiya kids. Here is an important message from your Uncle Bill. Don't buy drugs..... Become a pop star, and they give you them for free!
quote.zh: 哦，嗨，孩子们。这是你们比尔叔叔的一条重要信息。别买毒品……当上流行明星，他们就会免费给你！

quote.text: It could look like someone you know or it could be a stranger in a crowd. Whatever helps it get close to you.
quote.zh: 它可能看起来像你认识的人，也可能像人群中的陌生人。任何能帮助它靠近您的东西都可以。

quote.text: [repeated line] For relaxing times, make it Suntory time.
quote.zh: [重复台词] 想要放松一下，就来一杯三得利吧。

quote.text: Sand is overrated. It's just tiny little rocks.
quote.zh: 沙子被高估了。它不过是些小小的石头。

quote.text: I'm the best and cleanest witch in Ingary".
quote.zh: 我是英格瑞最优秀、最干净的巫师。”

quote.text: Even though I'm no better than a beast, don't I have the right to live?
quote.zh: 即使我不比禽兽好，难道我没有活下去的权利吗？

quote.text: [Response to David.] GET FUCKED, FOUR-EYES!
quote.zh: [回复David。]去你妈的，四眼仔！

quote.text: [To ice cream vendor] What're you looking at? Never seen an ice cream thief before? [Runs away without paying, laughing maniacally]
quote.zh: [对冰淇淋摊贩] 你看什么？以前没见过偷冰淇淋的吗？[不付钱就跑了，疯狂地大笑]

quote.text: That's L.A. They worship everything and they value nothing.
quote.zh: 这就是洛杉矶。他们崇拜一切，却不珍视任何东西。

quote.text: [repeated line] Fucking Chet.
quote.zh: [重复台词] 该死的切特。

quote.text: I'm designed to feel slightly dissatisfied.
quote.zh: 我的设计就是让我感到略微不满意。

quote.text: Anybody can lose one fight, anybody can lose once, you'll come back from this you'll be champion of the world.
quote.zh: 谁都可能输掉一场比赛，谁都可能输掉一次，你会从这次失利中振作起来，你会成为世界冠军。

quote.text: I'm concerned about a Chinaman who thinks it's wise to come to a business transaction with automatic weapons.
quote.zh: 我担心的是一个中国人，他认为带着自动武器来谈生意很明智。

quote.text: [echoing line from Shaun Of The Dead] What's the matter, Danny? Never taken a shortcut before?
quote.zh: [模仿《僵尸肖恩》中的台词]怎么了，丹尼？以前没走过捷径吗？

quote.text: [kissing gesture made to woman] Very nice. How much?
quote.zh: [向女士做出亲吻的手势]非常好。多少钱？

quote.text: [final words to Kingpin before his death] I know what you're trying to do– and it won't work. They're gone.
quote.zh: [临终前对金并说的最后一句话]我知道你想做什么——但没用的。他们已经走了。

quote.text: I have a competition in me. I want no one else to succeed. I hate most people.
quote.zh: 我心里有一种竞争意识。我不想让别人成功。我讨厌大多数人。

quote.text: Nothin wounded goes uphill, he said. It just dont happen.
quote.zh: 他说，受伤的人爬不上坡。这根本不可能。

quote.text: Are you watching closely?
quote.zh: 你在仔细看吗？

quote.text: [about the housekeeper] This bitch is crazy. Bitch is crazy.
